title: Camera handoff practice
concept: Plan a continuous handoff from the lead singer to another band member and back.

direction.directorStyle: Continuous movement timed to musical phrases
direction.lighting: Soft directional light; preserve natural skin detail
direction.colors: Warm subjects against a cooler background

scenes.title: Singer to guitarist and back
scenes.userNotes: Practice only: replace the timing and performance with your actual song.

shotPlan.middle: Travel to the guitarist on a musical response
shotPlan.end: Return to the singer on the next phrase
shotPlan.continuity: Maintain performer positions and lighting through the move

studio.performance: Keep singing and moving throughout the shot; the guitarist continues playing while attention changes.

performers.name: Lead singer
performers.action: Continue the vocal performance with expressive body movement.

performers.name: Guitarist
performers.action: Continue the musical performance and respond to the singer.

scenes.title: Reaction and story beat
scenes.userNotes: Add a distinct reaction picture when developing your real project.

lookbook.title: Handoff and return
lookbook.lesson: Keep both performers active throughout a continuous shot. Time attention changes to the music.
lookbook.movement: Singer to band member and back in one scene.
